answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 44 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The raven register is checked at draw time, lagoon lists the eligible set, and island seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 44 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. A farm of 95 pays that 152 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
